title: Implement meter aggregation and bands
description:
Implement aggregation over the records in a resolved window: thanks and F-bomb token counts, message-level counts, messages and sessions scanned, per-source breakdown. Gauge: thanks divided by (thanks plus F-bombs) when the denominator is positive, otherwise a quiet state; bands are config-driven (defaults: at least 0.75 mostly grateful, 0.40 to 0.75 mixed, below 0.40 cursing at the machine).

Done when: aggregation is deterministic, includes the window label, and unit tests cover the gauge, bands, and quiet case.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented computeMeter in src/sentiment/meter.ts: aggregation over in-window records (thanks and F-bomb token counts, message-level counts, messagesScanned, sessionsScanned, per-source breakdown with session sets), excludedMessages from the strippers, and the gauge thanks/(thanks+F-bombs) on token counts with a quiet state when the denominator is zero. Bands config-driven via MeterBands (defaults 0.75/0.40). Deterministic with the window label included; unit tests cover gauge, bands, quiet, determinism, and per-source breakdown. Outcome: green.
